parties: Gujarat Maritime Board; Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited
headline: Gujarat Maritime Board submits SEBI Takeover Disclosure for Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited
sum: Gujarat Maritime Board has filed a Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition or change in control at listed chemical manufacturer Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited.
implication: A Reg 31(4)/(5) disclosure triggers mandatory open offer obligations if GMB has acquired or intends to acquire control; counsel must immediately verify the acquisition threshold (25%+), exemption claims (if any), and the timeline for triggering the open offer under Regulation 3(c) read with Schedule 1.
detail: Gujarat Maritime Board has formally submitted disclosure documentation to the NSE under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This filing is the gateway notification of a material acquisition or change of control event at Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited, a listed chemical company. The disclosure itself does not reveal the acquisition price, stake size, or timeline; that detail is typically contained in the underlying Form DIS (Disclosure Form) filed with both NSE and BSE.
